summary: Backend + frontend testing of Maison Hue holding page. All 8 pytest cases passed. All key frontend flows (hero, story, waitlist submit, reserve submit, footer) verified via Playwright on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: logger is defined AFTER it is referenced in module-level functions (_send_email uses logger; logger initialised at bottom of server.py). It works only because _send_email runs after import-time evaluation, but Mongo-insert error paths (lines 157/194) also reference logger. Safer to define logger right after imports.
Minor: Using @app.on_event is deprecated in FastAPI; prefer lifespan handler.
Minor: Pydantic EmailStr accepts case-sensitive but server lowercases for DB; consistent and good. No issues.
test_credentials: None required. Admin email for sandbox verification: alisa_dedovic@msn.com
seed_data_creation: Test docs inserted with TEST_ prefix into MongoDB collections 'waitlist' and 'shade_reservations' (5 docs total during run). Not cleaned up — acceptable for fresh build.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_maison_hue.py cover root, counts, waitlist (valid non-admin, admin email sandbox path, invalid email, missing name), reserve (valid, missing hair_colour). Admin-email path confirmed email_sent=true & admin_notified=true via Resend sandbox. Non-admin emails correctly return 200 with email_sent likely false (expected sandbox behaviour, NOT a bug). Frontend Playwright flow validated all data-testids match HoldingPage.jsx.
